title: Yarn allowed to rewrite the lockfile during CI
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn setting that lets an install update the lockfile it was given. A CI run can resolve versions the review never saw and report success, so the committed lockfile stops describing what was built.
remediation: Enable immutable installs in CI so a drift fails the build instead of being written away.
limitation: It matches a Yarn setting that lets an install update the lockfile it was given in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
